responses.change: Replaced database event deletion with appending a compensating git.snapshot_create_failed event to the SQLite database journal on git ref update failure. Unified all four design documents to be consistent with this append-only behavior (Article III).

Updated task T010 in tasks.md to assert the current event-first ordering: (1) if initial event write fails, no git reference is created, and (2) if git ref write fails, the original event is retained and a compensating git.snapshot_create_failed event is appended.
